description:
Returns how one MCP endpoint refuses an unpaid call. Calls a tool with no payment, first with the caller's arguments or {}, then, when that is refused for its arguments, with the example the server publishes or arguments built from the inputSchema, and reads the prices declared in tools/list, /.well-known/x402 and /openapi.json; the verdict is paid, not_paid or undetermined, and every probe is listed with its answer. Terms are parsed with the canonical x402 schema: version, HTTP status against body (a 402 body under HTTP 200 is invisible to anything that counts by status), accepts rows and whether several share one (scheme, network) key so an indexer keeps only the last, non-schema keys, which asset sits first and last, and whether the refusal carries anything a wallet-less caller can act on. Then calls the same tool with a required argument missing and with an argument of the wrong type, and reports the order observed: payment first, validation first, mixed, or not determined when the schema gives nothing to vary. Never pays. It makes five or more requests to the server named and takes as long as they take, so call it on a line: a call cut for time returns nothing.
$0.000001 per millisecond on a line.
Paid, on a line. With no wallet code, ZEAM :: Pass buys the time and opens the line for you, with a pass (https://mcp.zeamprism.com/pass) or your own wallet: https://mcp.zeamprism.com/how-to-pay
Example: {"url":"https://mcp.zeamprism.com/mcp","tool":"audit_payers"}

arguments.description: optional object — arguments for that tool, sent first and as given; default: {}, then the example the server publishes for the tool, then arguments built from its inputSchema.

line.description: Optional. A line credential, for a client that cannot send the x-line header or _meta["zeam-pass/line"]: the call runs on that line's time.

probe.description: optional int — how many tools to try when `tool` is omitted; default 5.

tool.description: optional string — the tool to call unpaid; default: the first tool that answers an unpaid call with x402 terms, trying the tools the server prices first, then the unpriced ones in tools/list order (at most `probe` tools are tried).

url.description: string — the MCP endpoint, absolute http(s) URL, e.g. https://host/mcp. Private and internal names and addresses are refused.

name: attest_payment

anyOf.description: what the server itself says the tool costs: source, says (paid | free), price

every request made, in the order sent: method, url, request headers of note, status, ms; a request that drew no answer has status 0 and its error, a redirect followed is listed in redirects, and a request still unanswered when a report was cut has unanswered: true
live amount vs openapi x-payment-info for the same tool, when both exist
the unpaid call that drew terms: payment_required, where the terms were found, schema_ok, http_status, terms, accepts analysis, guidance keys, reading
every probe in order: tool, probe, arguments, answer, http_status, detail

order: payment-first | validation-first | mixed | not-determined, from the same tool called unpaid with valid arguments, with a required argument missing and with a wrong-typed argument; probes lists each call and its answer, refused_before_terms and terms_despite name the kinds
paid | not_paid | undetermined. not_paid only when an unpaid call ran or the server prices the tool free; a call refused for its arguments is undetermined

title: See how a server refuses an unpaid call
